title: Using the TBML Guidance Manual: Step-by-Step Process and Tool Application
organizations: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime
publisher: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime
purpose: Provide practical instructions for applying the TBML guidance manual alongside the Excel-based risk assessment tool.
assessment_steps: Evaluation of the TBML control landscape

threats_and_vulnerabilities.meaning: 0.0 means does not exist; 1.0 means most extreme; higher scores indicate greater exposure.

control_landscape.meaning: 0.0 means does not exist; 1.0 means excellent; higher scores indicate stronger mitigation.

tool_templates.master_template: Master Template for Overall TBML Risk
tool_templates.module_4_relationship: Module 4 may support Module 3.b and relevant parts of Modules 1 and 2, but does not directly feed the master template.

sources: Customs declarations, risk-management outputs, audits and seizures
Mutual legal assistance and international cooperation records

mainland: Proceeds of organized or serious crimes
free_trade_zones: Proceeds in major FTZ trade counterparts
threat_variables.interpretive_caution: Detected cases may reflect threat level, detection capacity, or both; interpret with the control-landscape assessment.

mainland: Shadow banking or informal credit facilities
free_trade_zones: Economic and trade significance of FTZs

control_landscape.principle: Effectiveness depends on quality, implementation, reach and outcomes, not merely formal existence.

anticipated_questions.missing_data: Use documented expert judgment, interviews or proxy indicators and record limitations as action-plan items.
anticipated_questions.stakeholder_disagreement: Use structured evidence review; document dissent and unresolved concerns if consensus is not reached.
anticipated_questions.multiple_sessions: Permitted; preserve continuity through assessment logs and working papers.
anticipated_questions.validation: Use peer review, external consultation, validation workshops and comparisons with other diagnostics.
anticipated_questions.excessive_detail: Prioritize material systemic weaknesses, enforcement gaps and high-risk sectors.

action_plan_components: Prevention, detection, investigation and prosecution measures
Public-private engagement and joint typology work
Owners, timelines, resources and progress indicators

source.title: Self-Assessment Guidance Manual for Trade-Based Money-Laundering Risk Assessment Tool
source.publisher: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime
